basis: Named authorship on the acquired report, including Auditors rows and executive-summary commissioning statements beyond image-only covers; repository or CDN hosting alone does not establish authorship.

families.rule: Prefer a single explicit prepared-by/audited-by author, otherwise a single named cover brand. Ambiguous co-branding retains the recorded attribution.

Keep the existing publisher IDs separate. Theori-only reports count as Theori. Explicit ChainLight team branding counts as ChainLight, including covers also mentioning Theori; an unambiguous explicit author label takes priority.
Prefer a single explicit commissioned/prepared-by author. Cantina hosting does not establish authorship of a Spearbit report. Otherwise use a single named cover brand.
Prefer the explicitly named commissioned author or single cover author over a portfolio/discovery attribution; a cited previous audit does not establish authorship.

provenance: Preserve collector publisher attribution and the source-named author evidence on each corrected document. Shared hosting is not joint authorship.
